verdict.rationale: Docs claim the agent 'resolves contradictions' and 'compares and evaluates multiple hypotheses' during autonomous research, implying some handling of conflicting sources, but there is no evidence of an analyst-facing feature that visibly shows where sources agree/disagree—only that contradictions are resolved internally before producing a single report. Missing for 10: explicit UI/report feature showing agreement/disagreement across sources, evidence of surfacing conflicting citations to the user, independent verification of this behavior.
